claim: A valid opportunistic passive second observation can materially reduce externally cued track error in many modeled regimes.
Performance is sensitive to donor density, residual clutter and bistatic RCS.
Metrology-conditioned EIG does not robustly outperform the strongest simple pulse-mode baseline.
Real RF dynamic range, emitter association, clutter suppression, bistatic RCS and field geolocation.
Patentability / novelty of the integrated architecture.
